data.title: Creekside 18
data.about:
Welcome to Creekside 18 in Dubai Creek Harbour. Located in the heart of the Creek Island, Creekside 18 offers you a choice of beautifully designed 2, 3, 4 bedroom apartments. Each apartment has large windows and balconies overlooking the Creek with views of the Dubai Creek Tower and Downtown Dubai.

These homes are ideally designed to have enough space for your entire family. With the Dubai International Airport, just a short drive away, Creekside 18, is located conveniently just minutes from the major city landmarks. It is also close to many gourmet restaurants, shopping destinations, as well as healthcare facilities. Amenities include a swimming pool, barbeque areas, gymnasium, as well as dedicated children’s play areas. Choose Creekside 18 to live that perfectly indulgent lifestyle. Dubai Creek Harbour is the best waterfront residential destination in Dubai.
